name: Rakshasa — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Rakshasa from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Mythic Rakshasa", "Rakshasa, Common" but are not part of the Rakshasa entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Mythic Rakshasa

Spells Known (CL 7th; concentration +12)

4th (5)—charm monster (DC 19), dimension door
3rd (7)—lightning bolt M (DC 18), suggestion M (DC 18), vampiric touch
2nd (7)—acid arrow, invisibility M, minor image (DC 17), mirror image
1st (8)—charm person (DC 16), mage armor, magic missile M, shield, silent image M (DC 16)

From d20pfsrd.com: Rakshasa, Common

Variant: Possessing Rakshasa (CR 10)

[Source]

These always appear to have the face of white tigers. Any shapeshifting form they take has an albino appearance, though creatures they possess do not. These rakshasa delight in hedonistic activities and especially in forcing individuals they possess into performing acts that would normally violate their nature.

Malevolence (Su)
